name: Agricultural Water Management
description: Soil water, root zone soil moisture, field capacity and permanent wilting point, soil quality, soil-water-plant relationships, soil water retention, leaching requirement, crop water requirement, irrigation systems: canal, Tubewell and tank irrigation systems, irrigation scheduling, water use efficiency, conjunctive water use, use of poor quality groundwater in agriculture, crop productivity, smart agriculture, water saving technologies: sprinkler and drip irrigation, soil moisture monitoring and management, water stress monitoring, real time crop health monitoring system; use of satellite remote sensing, drone, GIS, IoT and AI in agriculture, impact of climate change on agriculture, crop diversification and climate resilient agriculture; optimal utilization of water in agriculture for water and environmental sustainability, virtual water, specific water consumption and water footprint.
